options.name: crush_device_class
options.description: Restrict placement to devices of a specific class (hdd/ssd)

options.name: crush_failure_domain
options.description: Set the failure domain for the CRUSH rule (e.g., 'rack', 'host', 'osd')

options.name: directory
options.description: Set the directory name from which the erasure code plugin is loaded.

options.name: k
options.description: Number of data-chunks the object will be split in

options.name: m
options.description: Compute coding chunks for each object and store them on different OSDs.

options.name: plugin
options.description: Use the erasure code plugin to compute coding chunks and recover missing chunks.

options.name: state
options.description: If 'present' is used, the module creates a profile. If 'absent' is used, the module will delete the profile.

options.name: stripe_unit
options.description: The amount of data in a data chunk, per stripe.
